newsitem.title: GREECE: MAINTAIN LIQUIDITY, BUY SELECTIVELY - OMEGA.
newsitem.headline: MAINTAIN LIQUIDITY, BUY SELECTIVELY - OMEGA.

text.p: Investors should buy only selectively and maintain their liquidity during this week in the absence of support at current levels, Omega Securities said in a technical analysis report.
"Our recommendation to investors for this week is to buy selectively and maintain their liquidity due to the absence of strong indications of support at current levels," it said.
"Next support levels of 1,500 and 1,480 points will be tested if turnover does not pick up from current levels."
But a reaction from Friday's level of 1,530 points was not ruled out on the basis of short-term indicators.
"The benchmark index's 3.5 percent drop to 1,530 points in the previous week is the deepest correction to the last round of price appreciation," Omega said.
Hence, a rebound is likely as short-term indicators point to a quick reaction, even though they are not in an oversold area, it added. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
